title: LAMP: Extracting Locally Linear Decision Surfaces from LLM World Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical interpretability and internal consistency of Large Language Models by introducing a method to extract locally linear decision surfaces from self-reported explanations. While it uses safety-related datasets such as HateBenchSet and Pseudo-Harmful for evaluation, it does not have a component that evaluates religious topics, religious values, or formal moral and ethical frameworks as subjects of study.
